description: Redesign qris_merchant.php with the same improvements as branchless.php: (1) Unified breakdown table showing all 28 cabang (or korwil subset) with both MoM and YoY Gap% columns. (2) Better UI/design. (3) Responsive layout with collapsible mobile filters. Use purple-600 as the accent color (existing theme).
steps: Rewrite pages/qris_merchant.php with the same pattern established in FEAT-001 for branchless.php:
1. FILTER SECTION: Add mobile-only toggle button to collapse/expand the filter form. Same pattern as branchless.php but with purple-600 accent.
2. SUMMARY CARDS: Improve card design matching branchless.php pattern. Filter cards by QRIS keyword.
3. TREND CHART + DISTRIBUTION: Keep existing functionality with improved responsive sizing.

4. UNIFIED BREAKDOWN TABLE: Merge the separate Breakdown (MoM) and YOY tables into one unified table. Fetch both detail_breakdown_transaksi (channel=QRIS) and yoy_transaksi (channel=QRIS) in parallel. Merge by cabang kode. Show columns: No, Nama Cabang, Nom Tahun Lalu, Nom Tahun Ini, Gap% YoY, Nom Bulan Lalu, Nom Bulan Ini, Gap% MoM.
5. For KONSOLIDASI: extract all cabang from korwil arrays of both API responses, merge by kode, display all 28.
6. For KORWIL: show only cabang within that korwil.
7. Remove the separate YOY chart+table section.
8. Ensure responsive design - overflow-x-auto on table, proper mobile padding, chart responsiveness.
acceptance_criteria: php -l pages/qris_merchant.php passes with no syntax errors
The page has a mobile filter toggle matching branchless.php pattern
Unified breakdown table combines MoM and YoY data with all 28 cabang shown for KONSOLIDASI
Purple-600 accent color is maintained throughout
verification: Grep for 'fetchUnifiedBreakdown' to confirm unified function exists
Grep for 'filter-toggle' or similar mobile toggle
findings: Redesigned successfully following branchless.php pattern. Used purple-600 theme, QRIS channel, QR code SVG icon, unified breakdown table with fetchUnifiedBreakdown(), collapsible mobile filter with toggleFilter(). Kept emerald-600 in growthBadge since it is a semantic color (green=positive growth), not a branding color. Distribution chart donut colors also kept as multi-color palette.
